index.title: Envoys
index.description: Agents people can reach on chat platforms, each speaking through an account you connected.
index.emptyBody: To list an agent here, connect an account for it on a chat platform.

add.title: Connect an account
add.description: Pick the agent that speaks through the new account. The platform comes next.

newBot.title: Connect an account on {{app}} for <agent>{{agent}}</agent>
newBot.description: <agent>{{agent}}</agent> answers in every chat this account is in.
newBot.name: Account name in {{app}}
newBot.nameHint: People see this name in groups and @mention it.
newBot.scanBody: {{app}} creates the {{bot}} account and connects it to Rome.
newBot.delegateDescription: <agent>{{agent}}</agent> answers from your own account on your behalf. People in your chats see your name, not the agent's.
newBot.signInBody: Scan while signed in to your own account in the {{app}} app.

overview.noBots: To reach <agent>{{agent}}</agent> in a chat app, connect an account for it, then invite the account to a group or DM.

settings.introduce: Introduce itself when added to a group
settings.introduceBody: Posts one short hello with what it can help with.
settings.moveConfirm_one: Switch {{bot}} to <agent>{{to}}</agent>? <agent>{{to}}</agent> answers in its {{count}} chat from now on. It reads the chat's history as context and starts with fresh working memory.
settings.moveConfirm_other: Switch {{bot}} to <agent>{{to}}</agent>? <agent>{{to}}</agent> answers in its {{count}} chats from now on. It reads each chat's history as context and starts with fresh working memory.
settings.unlinkConfirm: Unlink <agent>{{agent}}</agent> from {{bot}}? {{bot}} stays connected, but Rome stops listening to its messages until you link an agent again.
settings.disconnectConfirm_one: Disconnect {{bot}}? Rome loses access to the account and stops answering in its {{count}} chat. The chat keeps its history while another of Rome's accounts is in it.
settings.disconnectConfirm_other: Disconnect {{bot}}? Rome loses access to the account and stops answering in its {{count}} chats. A chat keeps its history while another of Rome's accounts is in it.

choose.title: Connect an account for <agent>{{agent}}</agent>
choose.description: An agent can speak through any number of accounts, on one platform or several.
choose.ownBody: People see <agent>{{agent}}</agent> as a member of its own, under the account's name.
choose.delegateBody: <agent>{{agent}}</agent> answers from your account. People see your name on its replies.

feishu.name: Feishu
feishu.invite: Open a group, then Settings, Group bots, Add bot, and pick {{bot}}. To start a DM, search for {{bot}} in Feishu. Chats appear here on their own.

lark.name: Lark
lark.invite: Open a group, then Settings, Group bots, Add bot, and pick {{bot}}. To start a DM, search for {{bot}} in Lark. Chats appear here on their own.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.invite: Add {{bot}} to a group from its member list, or search for {{bot}} in Telegram to start a DM. Chats appear here on their own.
telegram.tokenHint: Create the bot with @BotFather in Telegram, then paste the token it gives you.

discord.name: Discord
discord.invite: Invite {{bot}} to a server with its install link, then @mention it in a channel. Chats appear here on their own.
discord.tokenHint: Create an application in the Discord Developer Portal, add a bot to it, and paste the bot's token.

wechat.name: WeChat
wechat.invite: Add {{bot}} to a group from its member list, or message {{bot}} directly in WeChat. Chats appear here on their own.

unlinked.title: Connected, no agent
unlinked.description: Rome has access to these accounts, but no agent speaks through them, so Rome does not listen to their messages.
